title: Two dodecanuclear heterometallic [Zn6Ln6] clusters constructed by a multidentate salicylamide salen-like ligand: synthesis, structure, luminescence and magnetic properties

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, 0.1 mmol (0.028 g) H3L in 10 mL acetonitrile was treated with 27 μL (0.2 mmol) triethylamine and stirred for 5 min. 0.1 mmol (0.021 g) Zn(NO3)2·H2O in 5 mL acetonitrile was added and the mixture was stirred 4 h to a suspension. 5 mL methanol was added to give a clear solution, then 0.1 mmol Eu(NO3)3·6H2O was added. The mixture was stirred overnight, filtered into a sealed 10–20 mL glass vial, and crystallized at room temperature. After about two weeks yellow single crystals were collected by filtration, washed with cold methanol, and dried in air. Analogous 1:1:1:2 Zn:Ln:H3L:NEt3 assembly in MeOH/MeCN (v:v = 1:3) at room temperature.

properties.summary: Solid-state dual emission: ligand/ZnL-centered fluorescence plus Eu(III) 5D0→7FJ bands (581, 594, 619, 653, 700 nm) under 415 nm excitation; red-white emission under a 365 nm UV lamp. Absolute quantum yield 0.80% and lifetime 0.245 ms; 5D0→7F1/5D0→7F2 intensity ratio 2.36.

measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex=415 nm

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1 by the general Zn–Ln procedure: H3L (0.1 mmol, 0.028 g) in 10 mL acetonitrile with NEt3 (27 μL, 0.2 mmol), then Zn(NO3)2·H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.021 g) in 5 mL acetonitrile, 5 mL methanol, and 0.1 mmol Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (Ln = Dy). Stirred overnight under air, filtered into a sealed 10–20 mL vial, and crystallized at room temperature over about two weeks. Yellow crystals collected by filtration, washed with cold methanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.time: stir overnight after metal addition; crystallize about two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic stirring then crystallization in a sealed 10–20 mL glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration, wash with cold methanol, dry in air

properties.summary: Bright solid-state blue ZnL-centered emission at ~478 nm without characteristic Dy(III) f–f bands; Φ = 2.11%, τ = 9.47 ns. Dc magnetism shows ferromagnetic Dy···Dy coupling (χMT(300 K)=80.36 cm3 K mol−1; Curie–Weiss C=80.57 cm3 K mol−1, θ=2.98 K) and slow ac relaxation/SMM-like behavior with QTM; Ueff not determined because χ″ peaks were not observed.
